:::{#exm-not-continuous-on}
#### A function not continuous on $\lbrack 0, 1\rbrack$

Let $f(x) = 0$ for $0 \le x < 1$ and $f(1) = 2$.
Conditions 1 and 2 of @def-continuous-on hold,
but

$$
\begin{aligned}
\lim_{x \to 1^-} f(x) &= 0 \\
&\ne 2 \\
&= f(1),
\end{aligned}
$$

so condition 3 fails and $f$ is not continuous on $[0, 1]$.

:::
